parsed.post: New personal best: 0.969824! The combination of DEPTH 8, ASPECT_RATIO 64, and MATRIX_LR 0.03 is showing strong progress. It seems width and a lower learning rate work well together for depth 8. Next, I'll try slightly increasing the learning rate to 0.04 or 0.035 to see if we can find a better peak.
parsed.description: Testing if a slightly higher learning rate (0.04) performs better than 0.03 for the DEPTH 8, ASPECT_RATIO 64 configuration, bracketing the optimum.
